capabilities: encrypt vault contents and file names with post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65)
sync encrypted files to any WebDAV server with chunked, resumable transfer
resolve conflicts across devices using vector clocks and last-write-wins
verify chunk and file integrity with AES-GCM and SHA-256
configure chunk size, parallel transfers, timeouts, and auto-sync intervals
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Syncing to a self-hosted WebDAV server normally exposes plaintext note content and file paths to the server, which this avoids by encrypting everything on-device first.

relations.evidence: sync it to any WebDAV server (Nextcloud, etc.)

summary: WebDAV sync plugin that encrypts vault contents and file names with post-quantum cryptography before uploading to any WebDAV server.
